["v1","en","COP21 → COP31 — Commitments & Achievements","Explore COP21–COP31 commitments, documented implementation and independently measured environmental outcomes. Conference years never substitute for scientific assessments; COP31 outcomes remain pending official adoption.","

Use the conference selector to compare agreements and remaining gaps. An optional progress marker links comparable regional observations to the shared planetary-boundaries chart, without changing its scientific values or attributing recovery to a COP.

"]
title: COP21 → COP31 — Toezeggingen en resultaten
summary: Er was geen COP in 2020. De conferentie staat los van wetenschappelijke beoordelingen en Fever-jaren.
insight: Holle groene markering: vergelijkbare regionale waarneming; geen mondiale grensverhouding of COP-resultaat. Wetenschappelijke vlakken en drempels blijven gelijk.
